94
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday, January 8, 2019/Pausha 18, 1940 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Ayurveda, Yoga & Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha and Homoeopathy
(AYUSH); Corporate Affairs; Culture; Finance; Health and Family Welfare;
Minority Affairs; New and Renewable Energy; Power; Tourism)
Total number of questions — 15
Expenditure on treatment of deaf and
dumb children
*271. DR. KANWAR DEEP SINGH:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) the expenditure incurred by the
Union and the State Governments on the
treatment of deaf and dumb children during
the last three years, State/UT-wise
including West Bengal and Punjab;
(b) the details of rules and conditions
laid down for the treatment; and
(c) the details of steps taken by
Government to make people aware of the
programmes/schemes being implemented
for the said children?
Budget for educational upliftment of
minorities
†*272. SHRI AHMAD ASHFAQUE
KARIM: Will the Minister of
MINORITY AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) the enhancement made in the budget
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
allocation by Government since 2014 till
date in comparison to budget allocation made
from 2009 to 2014 for educational
upliftment of minority communities;
(b) the extent to which Government has
implemented 15-point programme for the
welfare of minority communities, in
percentage; and
(c) the details of all works done under
15-point programme, point-wise?
Falling FDI inflow growth
*273. DR. ABHISHEK MANU
SINGHVI: Will the Minister of FINANCE
be pleased to state:
(a) the details of Foreign Direct
Investments (FDI) in the last three years;
(b) the reasons leading to FDI inflow
growth falling at a five year low of
3 per cent at USD 44.85 billion in 2017-18;
and
(c) the steps taken by Government to
enhance FDI in India?

95
Provision of Non-Practicing Allowance
to BAMS degree holders
*274. DR. SANJAY SINH: Will the
Minister of AYURVEDA, YOGA &
NATUROPATHY , UNANI, SIDDHA
AND HOMOEOPATHY be pleased to
state:
(a) the criteria for giving Non-Practicing
Allowance (NPA) to Ayurvedic Doctors
by Government;
(b) whether NPA can be granted to
holders of posts with BAMS qualification
only and even if not connected with medical
practice;
(c) the competent authority to approve
the grant of NPA; and
(d) the details of posts outside AYUSH,
which are not directly conneted with
medical practice and have been allowed
NPA in accordance with the provisions/
guidelines of AYUSH?
Loans to farmers affected by floods in
Kerala
*275. SHRI ABDUL WAHAB: Will the
Minister of FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has chalked
out any special scheme of giving loans to
the farmers in Kerala who were affected
and suffered during the recent floods in the
State; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Increase in Government's
contribution to NPS fund
*276. SHRI RA VI PRAKASH
VERMA: Will the Minister of FINANCE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Union Cabinet has recently
approved that Government's contribution
to NPS fund for Central Government
employees would be 14 per cent of basic
and DA instead of 10 per cent earlier;
(b) if so, the details thereof along with
the date of notification;
(c) whether pension of those
employees, who do not withdraw any
amount from NPS fund will be 50 per cent
of basic and DA would be admissible as is
in the case of old pension scheme; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
Rise in food items inflation
†*277. SHRI SURENDRA SINGH
NAGAR: Will the Minister of FINANCE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that food items
inflation has been on the rise constantly in
the country;
(b) if so, the steps being taken by
Government to control this inflation; and
(c) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
Strengthening healthcare
infrastructure in
Visakhapatnam, A.P.
*278. SHRI V . VIJAYASAI REDDY:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that under
National Health Mission (NHM),
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

96
Government has identified Visakhapatnam
in Andhra Pradesh as one of the High
Priority Districts which have weak
healthcare infrastructure;
(b) if so, the measures Government has
taken under NHM to strengthen the
healthcare infrastructure in Visakhapatnam;
(c) the details of fund allocated,
sanctioned, released and spent on health-
care infrastructure in Visakhapatnam and
physical targets set and achieved so far;
and
(d) which are the other districts
identified as High Priority Districts in
Andhra Pradesh and status of each district?
